verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair thing to ask of a SaaS accounting platform with a developer ecosystem, so the axis applies. The evidence shows an official MCP server, a PHP SDK and a Node.js OAuth client, but none of these is a command-line tool. The MCP server and SDKs are developer building blocks or belong to other stories, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
